DIABETES IN PREGNANCY

Pre conception counselling:

Individualized dietary advice.

Weight reduction if BMI >27.

Folic acid 5mg till 12 weeks.

Monthly HbA1C:

Aim < 48 mol/ mol – 6.5%.

C/I to pregnancy > 86mol/mol – 10%.

Stop other mediation pre – conceptionally.

Retinal assessment (if not done within 6m0).

Renal assessment (if not done within 6m0).

 

Referral to nephrologist:

Serum Creatinine > 1.2.

Albumin: Creatinine> 30 mg/nmol.

GFR < 45ml/min.

Gestational Diabetes:

R.F:

BMI > 30 screening @ 24 – 28 weeks.

Previous baby wight > 4.5k screening @ 24 – 28 weeks.

Previous GDM @ booking if normal then Repeat @ 24 – 28 weeks.

Family history screening @ 24 – 28 weeks.

Ethnicity screening @ 24 – 28 weeks.

Glycosuria:

2+ on single event.

1 + on 2 occasions

Indicate GDM

 

Further Testing OGTT.

OGTT:

75g OGTT, 2hours duration

At Booking (1st, 2nd ) – with previous GDM.

24 – 28 with previous normal OGTT.

Fasting > 5. 6 GDM refer to joint Diabetes

2 hours > 7.8 clinic within 1 week of diagnosis

Early self-monitoring – with previous history of GDM.

Education:

Fetomaternal risk.

Benefit of controlled BSL.

Self – monitoring of BSL.

Diet and exercise (walking 30min after meal daily).

Fasting BSL;

1.<7 mmol/ lit:

Insulin if Metformin C/I or not tolerated.

2. ≥ 7 offer insulin + diet + exercise + Metformin.

3.6 – 6.9 + complications.

Consider insulin + diet + exercise.

Offer Glibenclamide if Metformin not effective/Not tolerated.

Hypoglycemia & insulin Treatment:

Aspart/ Lispro – rapid acting – recommended during pregnancy.

Explain hypoglycemia and treatment:

Offer:

Unstable BSL.

To gain information about variability in BSL.

Ketone Monitoring/Testing:

Type I:

Offer strips & meter.

Home testing if unwell or raised BSL

Urgent help if ketones positive.

Type II + GDM:

Unwell or hyperglycemia | seek urgent help.

Urgent ketones

Positive ketones Admit level II.

Retinal Assessment:

Offer in preexisting DM (if not done in previous 3m0).

@ booking.

@ 28 weeks.

@ 6months after child birth.

Vaginal birth is not C/I in retinopathy.

Offer – (if not done in 3m0).

Creatinine > 1.2

Albumin: creatinine > 30mg/mol.

Protein excretion > 0.5g/ day.

Proteinuria > 5g/day.

BSL Monitoring During labour

+ Dextrose. - Type II, GDM:

Neonatal Care:

Delivery in unit where resuscitation available during 24 hours.

Encephalopathy.

Jaundice – requiring phototherapy.

Hypoglycemia:

Not effective feeding

Abnormal clinical signs. N – G feeding

< 2 mol on 2 reading or

Despite Max feeding. I/V dextrose.

Don’t Discharge before 24 hours.

PNC:

Reduce insulin dose immediately after birth.

Shift to pre pregnancy regimen or cut the dose up to 50% if it is diagnosed 1st time in pregnancy
